history.text:
Cadre AI is an AI strategy and implementation consultancy that helps businesses drive real revenue growth and improve EBITDA through AI. We focus on identifying the right AI strategy for your organization, integrating AI into existing systems and workflows, and delivering measurable business impact. Our services include AI strategy development, leadership and team training, AI engineering, and the design and deployment of AI agents.

We partner with companies to identify high-value use cases, implement AI solutions that align with business goals, and ensure sustainable transformation. According to MIT, companies that bring in a dedicated AI partner are three times more likely to succeed with their AI initiatives.

https://www.cadreai.com
should i build my own in-house AI capability ?

Building an in-house AI capability can be challenging and risky, especially given how quickly the AI landscape evolves. Most AI initiatives fail when handled internally because teams struggle to keep up with rapid changes in models, compliance, and best practices. In-house teams often lack the cross-industry experience needed to implement AI effectively and efficiently.

At Cadre AI, we see what works across multiple industries and clients, allowing us to deliver battle-tested solutions tailored to your business needs. Partnering with an experienced AI consultancy can accelerate your AI journey and avoid common pitfalls that come with in-house implementation.

If you're considering building in-house AI capabilities, it’s worth evaluating whether a strategic AI partner like Cadre AI could provide a faster, more impactful path to success.

https://www.cadreai.com/articles/why-hiring-in-house-ai-talent-will-fail
should i start with tool selection my journey to AI implementation?

Starting your AI implementation journey with tool selection is not the most effective approach. At Cadre AI, we recommend beginning with a deep understanding of your business processes and identifying where AI can create the most value. This involves mapping out workflows, calculating potential ROI for different use cases, and prioritizing based on impact and feasibility.

Once you have a clear picture of where AI can drive business impact, you can then select the right tools or custom solutions that align with your specific needs. Focusing on integration, workflow redesign, and adoption ensures that the tools you choose are implemented successfully and deliver measurable results.

For a step-by-step approach to AI implementation, we recommend starting with a structured strategy that aligns with your business goals.
